producer_report.summary: The explainer page now opens with a "Start here" section before "States of a piece of work". It has three parts: what firstmate is (3 sentences), a 6-step walk-through of one piece of work, and a 22-term glossary. The text is in a new file, studies/firstmate-work-handling/intro.json, and site.rs renders it. Every sentence and every firstmate glossary term cites existing claim ids, and the renderer rejects an empty or unknown citation. Eight glossary terms describe the page itself: state, transition, trigger, guard, counter, claim, pin and mark. They carry an "about this page" tag and no citation. A glossary entry with neither claims nor that tag is an error. I added three tests: intro and glossary appear before the states, uncited intro elements are rejected, and the real study renders the required terms. I also updated the design note and the changelog.

checks_run.note: wrote index.html; I deleted the output directory afterwards. I did not run the default `site` command, which writes to the gitignored site/.

open_issues: studies/firstmate-work-handling/claims.json is unchanged. The brief listed it as a deliverable, but its own assumption said no new claims were needed. The 'what firstmate is' text is therefore built from existing claims. It says dispatch, worker, isolated worktree, captain approval and script gates. It does not say 'supervisor with a crew', because no claim supports that wording.
The intro text lives in a new file, intro.json, which is not on the brief's deliverables list.
The new glossary and intro carry no extra CSS, so they use the existing page styling.
The live Pages page changes only after a push to main and a workflow run.
mistakes: My first CHANGELOG edit failed because '### Added' appears 7 times; I redid it with unique context.
My first attempt to write intro.json used a here-document, which the sandbox denied. I used the Write tool instead.
learnings: The study files are loaded by site::load, and the build test copies each of them into a temp tree, so a new study file needs adding to both the fixture and that copy list.
xtask/tests/policy.rs accepted a new JSON file under studies/ without any change.
The page's `cites` check already rejects an element with no claim or an unknown claim id, so the new elements reuse it.
desires: The firstmate source (AGENTS.md and the docs) in the working copy, so I could add a claim that says what firstmate is instead of leaning on the existing 22.
